headlines.text: 2021 brought us this moment: the IWGP United States Title made its debut as Jon Moxley vs. Yuji Nagata battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.07 ? a strong outing. Nagata's first American TV appearance in nearly 23 years ? Moxley debuted new "Wild Thing" entrance music for the occasion, and the two shared a genuine moment of mutual respect afterward, celebrating a career and a wrestling style that had largely gone out of style.
Flash back to 2023, when B.Cage & Strickland went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.44.

On this day in 2021, the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Miro vs. Darby Allin battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.64 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. Miro was challenging for gold for the very first time. It marked Darby Allin's 10th match with the title on the line. The end of a record-setting reign ? Miro's brutal pre-bell beatdown set the tone, but Allin fought back with real heart before finally submitting to the Game Over, ending his 186-day championship run and delivering an emotional, tearful farewell speech afterward.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when The Young Bucks vs. SCU (Daniels & Kaz) went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.98 ? a solid showing. SCU (Daniels & Kaz) was challenging for gold for the very first time.
It was 2023 when Kyle Fletcher vs. Action Andretti locked horns for the first time on Rampage, rated 6.77.
That Friday in 2023, Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. The Butcher and The Blade & Sabian crossed paths for the first time ever, opening the card on Rampage, rated 5.25.
